purpose: Stock fuel-cut block relocation and alternate-entry diagnostic comparison.
known_limits: No measured ignition/EST/DFI/coil, bench readback, interrupted-write recovery or vehicle qualification is claimed.
Full logical 128 KiB program image. An initial CAL-only write does not install program changes.
Use the exact declared program parent. Do not stack with other cave/hook/RAM users or logger/RBCP/OneROM additions.
ASM-to-BIN parity and instruction-subset models do not prove whole-ECU IRQ, timing, stack or shared-state ownership.
This is a logical PCM image, not a transformed OneROM carrier file.
Relocates the original factory fuel-cut block; does not implement a new ignition cut.
The alternate native 0xA564 to 0xA5C3 entry remains unchanged. The detour rejoins bank2 0xA647 without a new return frame.
Entry-equivalence checks assume the declared bank2 view. Actual bank latching, IRQ interleaving and execution timing are unproved.
This separately named reviewed diagnostic copy does not alter legacy source/catalog DO_NOT_FLASH status or qualify other builds from those sources.

host_review.tests: 37 bounded tests and 196608 fixed-bank entry-equivalence cases passed; independent A09 reconstruction
